arxiv-2104-12537.title: Computer Vision in Automated Parking Systems: Design, Implementation and Challenges Journal: Image and Vision Computing
arxiv-2104-12537.creator: Markus Heimberger, Jonathan Horgan, Ciaran Hughes, John McDonald, Senthil Yogamani
arxiv-2104-12537.description: Abstract Automated driving is an active area of research in both industry and academia. Automated Parking, which is automated driving in a restricted scenario of parking with low speed manoeuvring, is a key enabling product for fully autonomous driving systems.

arxiv-2110-02382.title: A mean field thermodynamic framework for time dependent self-assembly and pattern formation
arxiv-2110-02382.creator: Michael Nguyen 1,2 , Suriyanarayanan Vaikuntanathan 1,2
arxiv-2110-02382.description: Abstract In this work, we use a minimal model to introduce a framework for controlling self-assembly under the influence of time-dependent driving forces. We develop a mean-field thermodynamic framework that predicts the conditions required to reliably self-assemble a desired spatial pattern under time-varying external fields.

arxiv-2202-03721.title: Predicting and Visualizing Daily Mood of People Using Tracking Data of Consumer Devices and Services
arxiv-2202-03721.creator: Christian Reiser
arxiv-2202-03721.description: Abstract Users can easily export personal data from devices (e.g., weather station and fitness tracker) and services (e.g., screentime tracker and commits on GitHub) they use but struggle to gain valuable insights. To tackle this problem, we present the self-tracking meta app called InsightMe , which aims to show users how data relate to their wellbeing, health, and performance.

arxiv-2310-05525.title: Physical Layer Security in a Private 5G Network for Industrial and Mobility Application
arxiv-2310-05525.creator: Shivraj Hanumant Gonde, Martin Kubisch, Christoph Frisch, Thomas Meyerhoff, Svetoslav Duhovnikov, Dominic Schupke
arxiv-2310-05525.description: Abstract Cellular communication technologies such as 5G are deployed on a large scale around the world. Compared to other communication technologies such as WiFi, Bluetooth, or Ultra Wideband (UWB), the 5G communication standard describes support for a large variety of use cases, e.g., Internet of Things (IoT), vehicular, industrial, and campus-wide communications.

arxiv-2405-19693.title: Constraining small-scale primordial magnetic fields from the abundance of primordial black holes
arxiv-2405-19693.creator: Ashu Kushwaha, and Teruaki Suyama
arxiv-2405-19693.description: Abstract The presence of magnetic fields in the early universe affects the cosmological processes, leading to the distinct signature, which allows constraining their properties and the genesis mechanisms. In this study, we revisit the method to constrain the amplitude of the magnetic fields on small scales in the radiation-dominated era from the abundance of primordial black holes.

arxiv-2501-07538.title: Testing γ ​ δ \gamma\delta CDM Model in the Redshift Bins
arxiv-2501-07538.creator: Furkan Şakir Dilsiz, Cemsinan Deliduman, Selinay Sude Binici
arxiv-2501-07538.description: Abstract The Hubble crisis is the discrepancy in the values of the Hubble constant inferred from diverse observations in the late and early Universe, being of the order 5 σ \sigma . Instead of resolution, the conflict is getting larger with further late-time observations.

arxiv-2506-00099.title: Finance as Extended Biology: Reciprocity as the Cognitive Substrate of Financial Behavior
arxiv-2506-00099.creator: Egil Diau
arxiv-2506-00099.description: Abstract A central challenge in economics and artificial intelligence is explaining how financial behaviors—such as credit, insurance, and trade—emerge without formal institutions. We argue that these functions are not products of institutional design, but structured extensions of a single behavioral substrate: reciprocity.

arxiv-2506-14072.title: A generalization of Deterministic Finite Automata related to discharging
arxiv-2506-14072.description: Abstract Deterministic Finite Automata (DFAs) are of central importance in automata theory. In view of how state diagrams for DFAs are defined using directed graphs, this leads us to introduce a generalization of DFAs related to a method widely used in graph theory referred to as the discharging method .

arxiv-2510-06777.title: Strong Dinatural Transformations and Generalised Codensity Monads Volume: NN Journal: Electronic Notes in Theoretical Informatics and Computer Science Email: mpirog@cs.uni.wroc.pl Email: f.sieczkowski@hw.ac.uk
arxiv-2510-06777.creator: Maciej Piróg a, Filip Sieczkowski b
arxiv-2510-06777.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Maciej Piróg a, Filip Sieczkowski b. We introduce dicodensity monads : a generalisation of pointwise codensity monads generated by functors to monads generated by mixed-variant bifunctors. Our construction is based on the notion of strong dinaturality (also known as Barr dinaturality), and is inspired by denotational models of certain types in polymorphic lambda calculi – in particular, a form of continuation monads with universally quantified variables, such as the Church encoding of the list monad in System F.

pmc-11473811.title: Best treatment option for secondary mitral regurgitation surgery: a network meta-analysis of randomized and non-randomized controlled studies
pmc-11473811.creator: Francesco Nappi, Antonio Salsano, Arnaldo Dimagli, Francesco Santini, IvanCarmine Gambardella, Omar Ellouze
pmc-11473811.description: The objective of this study is to ascertain whether subvalvular papillary muscle repair in conjunction with restrictive mitral valve annuloplasty represents the most efficacious treatment for patients presenting with secondary ischemic mitral regurgitation, as compared to restrictive mitral valve annuloplasty alone and to mitral valve replacement.

pmc-11608213.title: Increase in Blood Eosinophil Count Over Time and Sputum IL8 are Associated with FEV1 Decline in Asthma
pmc-11608213.creator: S. Graff, C. Moermans, S. Gerday, M. Henket, V. Paulus, F. Guissard, R. Louis, F. Schleich
pmc-11608213.description: BackgroundAsthma is associated with accelerated rate of FEV1 decline.ObjectiveTo determine predictive factors associated with accelerated FEV1 decline in adult asthma and evaluate sputum cytokines as potential biomarkers for airflow decline.MethodsWe recruited 125 asthmatics evaluated at the asthma clinic of Liège and reevaluated them at least 5 years later.

pmc-11613392.title: Exploring the quality of life of pediatric trainees: Mixed-method explanatory design
pmc-11613392.creator: Hina Mumtaz Hashmi, Asma Pethani, Sana Saeed, Ali Faisal Saleem
pmc-11613392.description: Objective:Healthcare workers are at a higher risk of burnout. The aim of the study was to explore the professional quality of life (QOL) i.e. {Compassion Satisfaction (CS), Burnout (BO) and Secondary Traumatic Stress (STS)} and association of different trainee factors on QOL amongst Pediatric specialty trainees at a private tertiary care hospital in Karachi, Pakistan.

pmc-12511778.title: The mechanism of heat stress-induced injury in the immature oocytes of zebrafish (Danio rerio)
pmc-12511778.creator: Yanuar ACHADRI, Nao KUWAHARA, Momoko KIMURA, Nami KANAMARU, Kazutsugu MATSUKAWA, Keisuke EDASHIGE
pmc-12511778.description: Immature zebrafish oocytes are highly susceptible to high temperatures, making it difficult to warm cryopreserved oocytes rapidly. In the present study, we aimed to investigate whether thermosensitive channels, lipid mediators, and ferroptosis are involved in heat stress-induced injury in immature zebrafish oocytes.

pmc-12541339.title: Dynamic sensor selection for biomarker discovery
pmc-12541339.creator: Joshua Pickard, Cooper Stansbury, Amit Surana, Lindsey Muir, Anthony Bloch, Indika Rajapakse
pmc-12541339.description: SignificanceThere is an outstanding need to discover and improve biomarkers that monitor biological systems in research and clinical settings. We leverage observability theory to identify the optimal time-dependent biomarkers from experimental data. We demonstrate the technique on biomedical and agricultural genomics, electroencephalogram, and endomicroscopy data.

pmc-12609406.title: Sustainable Valorization of Grape Pomace in Sheep Through Systemic Health, Metabolic Safety, Milk and Meat Quality
pmc-12609406.creator: Gabriella Guelfi, Piermario Mangili, Francesca Mercati, David Ranucci, Silvia Crotti, Muhammad Tuseef, Gianluca Veneziani, Vicente Francisco Ratto, Camilla Capaccia, Francesco Ciancabilla, Margherita Maranesi, Cecilia Dall’Aglio, Diego A Moreno
pmc-12609406.description: Grape pomace (GP), a by-product of winemaking, is rich in polyphenols and fiber, making it a promising and sustainable feed supplement for ruminants. This study evaluated the safety and productive impact of a 5% GP-supplemented diet (GP5) including non-lactating end-cycle (EC) ewes regularly destined for slaughter and human consumption, and lactating (LAC) ewes, over a 30-day period.

pmc-13194260.title: Preoperative Quality of Life as Predictor of Postoperative Early Recurrence and Overall Survival in Patients with Pancreatic and Periampullary Adenocarcinoma
pmc-13194260.creator: Carsten Palnaes Hansen, Lise Munk Plum, Jan Henrik Storkholm, Hans-Christian Pommergaard
pmc-13194260.description: BackgroundThe purpose of the study was to investigate if preoperative assessment of quality of life (QoL) in patients with pancreatic and periampullary cancer can identify patients with reduced recurrence free and overall survival after pancreatic surgery.MethodsA prospective study of patients planned for pancreatic surgery due to pancreatic and periampullary tumors.

pmc-13229108.title: Reply to Ritson-Williams et al. and Loya and van Woesik: Coral replacement research is vital due to uncertainty and unprecedented stress
pmc-13229108.creator: Alejandro E. Camacho, David A. Dana, Mikhail Matz
pmc-13229108.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). tually serve to support our proposal for rigorous, democratically informed multistage research exploring ER’s tradeoffs. The submitted commentary has three broad recurrent themes: 1) ER can cause harm, most notably through unintended introduction of pathogens; 2) it may not work, either because introduced corals would not survive or would be unable to establish symbiosis; and 3) ER may only be considered when all other options are exhausted. We agree on all three accounts.

pmc-13352134.title: Invasive Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Larynx in a Dog
pmc-13352134.creator: Edenilson Doná Frigerio, Samira das Mercês Saboia Bezerra, Luísa Husz Toledo, Bruna Rodrigues Ferreira Sengue, Maria Eduarda Roselli Silvério, Igor Luiz Salardani Senhorello, Alexandre Lima de Andrade, Daniela Bernadete Rozza, Gisele Fabrino Machado, Jun Tamura
pmc-13352134.description: Squamous cell carcinoma (SCC) is a malignant epithelial neoplasm commonly affecting the skin and oral cavity of dogs, whereas laryngeal involvement is considered rare. Neoplasms arising in the larynx may cause severe upper airway obstruction and present diagnostic and therapeutic challenges due to the anatomical and functional constraints of this region.

pmc-13626901.title: Factors associated with orthostatic hypotension presence and severity in multiple system atrophy: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13626901.creator: Kaige Zhang, Xuan Xu, Yao Wang, Han Zhang, Liye Wang, Yunxian Wang, Meiqi Wei, Nannan Li, Zhigang Chen
pmc-13626901.description: BackgroundThe factors governing the presence and severity of orthostatic hypotension (OH) in multiple system atrophy (MSA) may differ. We investigated factors independently associated with OH and severe OH in MSA, and assessed the consistency of these associations across subtypes.MethodsWe examined the clinical data of 242 MSA patients who had blood pressure evaluations to assess OH.
